title: Quartz sand grains
description: Rounded, translucent grains about 0.1–1 mm across. Rounding comes from abrasion during transport by water or wind.
abstraction: Image is a procedurally generated illustration, not a photograph.

title: Sodium chloride crystals
description: Cubic crystals: their shape reflects the cubic arrangement of Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions in the lattice.

title: Sucrose crystals
description: Monoclinic crystals with slanted faces — a different shape from salt because sucrose molecules pack differently.

title: Leaf epidermis
description: Irregular epidermal cells and pairs of guard cells surrounding stomata — pores that let carbon dioxide in and water vapour out.
abstraction: Illustration of a typical dicot leaf; Minecraft leaves have no real anatomy.

title: Kelp tissue
description: Brown algal cells packed with golden-brown chloroplasts containing the pigment fucoxanthin.

title: Feather barbs
description: Parallel barbs carry tiny barbules with hooks that zip neighbouring barbs together into a smooth vane.

title: Etched iron (metallography)
description: Polished and etched iron shows polygonal crystal grains; grain size affects strength.
abstraction: Illustration of ferrite grains; real samples need polishing and acid etching.

title: Bone tissue
description: Concentric rings (osteons) around central canals that carried blood vessels.
